    Args:
        file_path: Path to the CSV file to parse. Can be a string or a
            ``pathlib.Path`` object.
        delimiter: Field delimiter used in the CSV file. Defaults to ``,``.
        encoding: Text encoding used to read the file. Defaults to ``utf-8``.
        strip_whitespace: If ``True``, leading and trailing whitespace is
            stripped from each cell value. Defaults to ``True``.

    Returns:
